title: Owner enquiry queue
significance: Business intake and access to production and design routing. Queue rows are masked.

title: Designer routing availability
significance: Shows workload and pause/resume controls. Only the synthetic designer card is included.

title: Public print studio
significance: Interactive print-family discovery leads into the quote journey.

title: Guided quote request
significance: Customers can ask for guidance instead of knowing technical print specifications.

title: Enquiry saved with reference
significance: Confirms the request and scanned reference are saved; tracking credentials are masked.

title: Quotation issued
significance: Business commercial approval and the immutable quotation presented for customer review.

title: Customer account activation
significance: A guest receives temporary access and must choose a password before using the account.

title: Quotation PDF preview
significance: A multipage commercial quotation can be read without downloading.

title: Designer assigned automatically
significance: Acceptance allocates the available synthetic designer without a manual assignment action.

title: Accepted customer work
significance: The wide work page orders the stages and keeps the project conversation on the right.

title: Designer proof workspace
significance: The assigned designer shares a scanned proof tied to the accepted quotation.

title: Customer pinned feedback
significance: Location comments tell the designer which part of the proof needs revision.

title: Revised proof approved
significance: Approval belongs to the exact revision and unlocks the production handoff.

title: Advance and balance agreement
significance: Payment terms are explicitly agreed before production.

title: Customer invoice PDF
significance: The issued commercial invoice is available as a private PDF download in the customer workspace.

title: Production assignment
significance: Owner selects the printer, machine, urgency and due date for released work.

title: Owner production board
significance: The scoped board shows the job in its actual operation lane, with assignment and urgency.

title: Printer assigned queue
significance: The printer sees only their own production jobs.

title: Production hold
significance: A reasoned hold pauses stage movement.

title: Production resumed
significance: The hold is resolved before work advances.

title: Printing operation
significance: The printer explicitly records that printing has started.

title: Finishing operation
significance: A handoff separates printing from finishing.

title: Quality check queue
significance: Quality review follows finishing.

title: Quality rework loop
significance: Failed quality review sends the job back to printing with a reason.

title: Finishing after rework
significance: The revised work passes through finishing again.

title: Quality recheck
significance: A new quality review is required after rework.

title: Ready for dispatch
significance: Passing QC updates both the production queue and fulfilment readiness.

title: Assigned delivery task
significance: The delivery staff account sees its own pickup-to-delivery instructions.

title: Pickup evidence gate
significance: Dispatch remains blocked until the required pickup image has passed scanning.

title: Pickup photo recorded
significance: Private scanned pickup evidence is attached to the assigned work.

title: Transit photo recorded
significance: An optional transit image documents the journey between dispatch and delivery.

title: Delivery evidence before confirmation
significance: Delivery evidence is uploaded before staff confirm the final handover.

title: Delivery confirmed
significance: Delivery starts the existing 48-hour customer review period.

title: Customer delivery photo gallery
significance: The customer can review pickup, transit and delivery images without downloading.
